name: Contractor Company (player PMC)
inspired_by: A small Western private military company working security and combat contracts for allied governments

doctrine.summary: The player's company: 8-strong squads (player + 7 AI) in four battle-buddy pairs, deploying from a leased LHD on coastal maps or a FOB inland. Starts as a lightly equipped counter-terror contractor and grows through contract pay, salvage and allied reputation purchases.
doctrine.fireteam: Two 4-man fireteams, each two battle-buddy pairs; player leads Alpha, AI team leader runs Bravo.
tactics: Battle-buddy pairs: one moves, one covers; never leave a buddy
Frags and flashbangs for room clearing; smoke to cover movement and casualty extraction
Player chooses extraction timing in hot zones
Strict civilian discipline: casualties cost money and reputation; 8 voids the contract

rifleman: M4 carbine (5.56x45mm) - starting weapon with 2 spare magazines
autorifleman: M249 / FN Minimi (5.56x45mm) - unlocked by purchase or salvage

body_armor.notes: Starting kit: light helmet and light aramid vest (frontal fragment + some ballistic). Upgrades by purchase: light plate (stops .223 at most), medium (front/back ceramic or steel), heavy (front/back/sides), helmets up to heavy (NIJ III++).

vehicles.notes: First armoured vehicle the player can own. Must be bought from usa first (player_trade, rep 30); turret with M2/M240.
Squad carrier for convoy escort contracts. Must be bought from usa first (player_trade, rep 45).
PROPOSAL: captured or locally bought Hilux technical; cheap, unarmoured against 7.62x54R+.
PROPOSAL: hired/leased lift from the LHD or FOB for insertion and extraction.
PROPOSAL: ex-USMC surplus amphibious carrier for LHD shore landings (USMC retired the AAV in 2025, surplus sold to allies).
Close air support. Must be bought first: unlocked as a usa CAS purchase at rep 75 and flown from an allied USMC LHD.

support_assets: LHD deployment hub for coastal maps (helicopter insertion, AAV landing, resupply)
FOB deployment hub for inland maps (vehicle staging, mortar pit, medical station)
Hired lift (UH-60) and allied CAS / fire missions bought through faction reputation
notes: Starting kit per design: M4, 2 spare magazines, 1 smoke grenade, 1 frag grenade. Contracts come from the regional contract board and faction fixers; taking work from one side locks the player out of that side's enemies' contracts for a while. Civilian casualties caused by the player or AI cost money and reputation; 8 void a contract. Early game is dominated by counter-terror work in the Middle East and affiliate theatres. Which vehicles the player can own (vs hire) is an open design question; all vehicles here are proposals using existing voxel models. The AH-1Z, MaxxPro, M-ATV, Bradley and Abrams are fielded by their real operators (Captain-confirmed 2026-10-10); the player faction also lists the M-ATV, MaxxPro and AH-1Z, but every player vehicle and support asset must be bought (player_trade or a support purchase) before it can be used (Captain-confirmed 2026-10-10). M-ATVs come from usa at rep 30, MaxxPros at rep 45, and AH-1Z close air support at rep 75. The player_mounted_squad template uses bought M-ATVs.
